$comment: simulation-observables/1 (contracts CV-A1, Geant4 program A1.5; owner contracts, content proposed by hep-detector): the observables a simulation run summary accumulates. An array of declarations; a study spec's top-level observables and a simulation program's output.observables reference it. Fields may be added (R2).

selection.description: conditions on per-event columns, all of which must hold (AND)

bins.description: fixed binning [lo, hi) in bins of width; (hi - lo) / width is a positive integer

thresholds.description: count_if counts events with x > threshold (strictly greater)

tolerance.description: required under tolerance_mode absolute, in the observable's unit
